dst_mac.description: Destination MAC address in colon-separated hex notation.

src_mac.description: Source MAC address in colon-separated hex notation.

ethertype.description: EtherType value in hex notation (e.g., 0x0800 for IPv4, 0x0806 for ARP).

interface.description: The network interface name to bind to for sending packets.

packet_count.description: Number of packets to generate and send.

payload_length.description: Length of the payload data in bytes.

delay.description: Delay in seconds between sending each packet.

verbose.description: Enable verbose mode to print packet details to stdout.
